t: A Code.org Hour of Code activity where students train a model to spot fish.
steps: Open the AI for Oceans page at code.org/oceans on a desktop or laptop.
Read the AI for Oceans lesson plan for your grade band.
Decide whether students will sign in. Sign-in is optional.
Show the warm-up video and lead a short talk.
Let students label images as fish or not fish.
Have students train the model on a word of their choice.
Close with a class talk on bias in training data.
